title: Mature product intent safely
statement: As a product manager, I can keep a story proposed while its success conditions are still being shaped and accept it only after observable criteria exist so draft intent is not mistaken for a commitment.
overview:
Product discovery should preserve uncertainty. A proposed story may describe a useful outcome before the team knows its exact success conditions. Acceptance requires at least one independent, observable criterion; creating a polished page does not move the story into the accepted state.

Feature and story overviews explain purpose and boundaries. Criterion titles and explanations improve readability while keeping the full pass/fail statement visible. Those fields are part of the obligation assessed by current evidence, so revisions retain explicit parentage and may require relationship reassessment.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A story with no acceptance criteria can remain in the proposed state.
Attempting to record an accepted lifecycle event for a story with no acceptance criteria is rejected without creating that event.
